gpuWorkaround.status: validated on development Chromium browser; per-analysis WASM gate retained
gpuWorkaround.cause: ReduceL2 WebGPU normalization: same-rank reductions with different widths reuse a shader whose loop bound is generated from a particular shape. Intermediate tensors match until the first width64 normalization. Minimal two-width all-ones reproduction produces sqrt(64) for the width32 reduction.
gpuWorkaround.implementation: GPU only: hash-bound byte patch replaces25 ReduceL2 with Mul(x,x), ReduceSum using equivalent axes/keepdims, Sqrt; copied learned parameters unchanged. Original WASM model remains the reference.

gpuWorkaround.performanceCaution: GPU processing is measured separately from the intentionally expensive original-WASM parity check and graph-patch preparation. Single development runs, no statistical speed claim.
